# Every *core.Service method the full role can call (ADR 0002), one per line.
# TestFullSurfacePinned fails until this matches rpcbind.Expose. Adding a
# line exposes a method to the user's programs: if it sends or egresses, say
# so in the PR and add it to audit in bind.go (ADR 0003); if it should not be
# on the wire at all, add it to hidden in bind.go instead.
